Oscar Piastri raced only for McLaren in 2023, 2024 and 2025, and his only teammate in each of those seasons was Lando Norris. Norris won the 2025 drivers' championship, which is in the champions list (2000–2025). So Norris is the only teammate who fits.

ANSWER: Lando Norris
